summary: Can we even discuss the morality @randpaul? I think we need legislation banning NDAs about sexual relations (with rape and incest exception). These are only used by people like @realdonaldtrump to buy the silence from the more vulnerable.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: Can we even discuss the morality @randpaul? I think we need legislation banning NDAs about sexual relations (with rape and incest exception). These are only used by people like @realdonaldtrump to buy the silence from the more vulnerable.
